prompt: This is one panel from a painted graphic novel. REFRAME as a closer medium shot: the frame is filled by the red-caped ape slumped in the floral armchair, from the knees up, with the lamp and the shelves of books and pictures behind him. The plumber and the maroon-jacketed ape are out of frame to the left. Same painting, same pose, same light.
